existing_identity_bindings.hir_borrow_owner: HirExprKind::PlaceAccess with HirPlacePlan.access BORROW_SHARED or BORROW_INOUT

loan_site_projection.end_operation_ids: nonempty canonical-sorted unique static LOAN_END operation identities
loan_site_projection.root_rule: a Shared or Exclusive root has parent_loan_id_or_null null and one matching LOAN_BEGIN_SHARED or LOAN_BEGIN_EXCLUSIVE
loan_site_projection.reborrow_rule: a reborrow has one parent LoanId, one LOAN_BEGIN_REBORROW whose payload names that parent, and a strictly contained region
loan_site_projection.view_release_rule: the matching LOAN_END invalidates every borrowed or inout view value for the activation and discharges ViewRelease exactly once through its ACCESS token

close_frontier.input: verified HIR region constraints, OwnershipDecisionInputR1 LoanDef facts, and the complete MIR CFG
close_frontier.selection: the earliest edge frontier after every authorized use and active child, before every conflicting owner barrier, region exit, or unadmitted suspension
close_frontier.critical_edge_policy: split an edge when an end belongs to only part of the successor frontier
close_frontier.static_site_rule: one loan site may name multiple static LOAN_END operations only when the corresponding paths are mutually exclusive
close_frontier.dynamic_balance_rule: each dynamic begin activation executes exactly one matching end on every reachable normal, Error, Defect, Cancellation, early-exit, and terminal path
close_frontier.loop_rule: a loop-carried path must return the site to INACTIVE before its backedge; a later iteration starts a fresh dynamic activation of the same static LoanId site
close_frontier.join_rule: every predecessor presents byte-identical loan state and ACCESS-token state for every in-scope LoanId

state_machine.begin: INACTIVE to ACTIVE and produce exactly one ACCESS token bound to the LoanId
state_machine.reborrow_begin: ACTIVE parent to SUSPENDED_BY_CHILD parent plus ACTIVE child
state_machine.child_end: ACTIVE child to INACTIVE child; resume only its immediate SUSPENDED_BY_CHILD parent
state_machine.root_end: ACTIVE root to INACTIVE root and discharge exactly its ACCESS token
state_machine.repeat_activation: INACTIVE may begin again only through a later dynamic execution of the same static begin operation
forbidden: begin while the same activation is ACTIVE or SUSPENDED_BY_CHILD
end a parent while any direct or transitive child is active
join unequal loan or ACCESS-token states

owner_barriers.law: every overlapping active loan closes before the barrier; the barrier does not synthesize a missing LOAN_END
owner_barriers.deferred_cleanup_use: a deferred call that consumes a borrow is an authorized final use; invoke it, end the loan, then begin conflicting owner cleanup
owner_barriers.r32_dependency: future fusion revalidates prepared-call rollback ends in reverse acquisition order; this candidate imports no R32 bytes or decisions

suspension.default: ordinary active loans close before SUSPEND
suspension.admitted_crossing: only an existing suspension proof may carry the exact ACCESS token in SuspensionSite.live_token_ids with matching region and isolation evidence
suspension.process_static_shared_exception: the already registered immutable process-static Shared profile remains the sole initial exception
suspension.generator_yield: an ordinary borrowed element or view closes before yield, next advance, continue, break, or loop exit unless an existing proof admits the carried value

end_semantics.token_flow: consume exactly one ACCESS token bound to the ended LoanId

observability.optional_debug_trace: LOAN_BEGIN and LOAN_END may appear in verifier/debug receipts without becoming language I/O or failure observations
observability.xvm_or_cranelift_erasure: allowed only after verification and only when alias, owner-barrier, suspension, cleanup, and failure-order observations remain unchanged
